---
title: "Send your first simulated voice note"
---

Follow the [simulator requirements](simulator-test-reference.qmd#environment) and stop the Voicenotes receiver.

1. Run `just android-emulator` in its own terminal and wait for Android to boot.
2. From the repository root, build and open the inbox.

   ```sh
   just android-build
   just android-preview demo
   ```

3. Run `just garmin-simulator`, then `just garmin-run-fixture`. In the Garmin simulator, choose **adb Connection → Start** and wait for **Connected · inbox up to date** on Android.
4. Press START on the simulated watch. The two-second sample arrives and plays on Android. The watch shows **On phone** in **Saved notes**.
5. Tap **Play note** on Android to hear it again.

[Run the automated simulator checks](run-simulator-tests.qmd)
